decisions.reason: As a recently launched printer close to the core marking portfolio, it benefits from sunk development effort, strategic fit with the firm's hardware business, and no clear evidence of failure that would overcome management's commitment.

The software module was publicly launched and directly supports the firm's stated move toward digitalization, serialization and end-to-end traceability, so management is very likely to persist with it.

This coder extends the established offer to an important substrate category and, in a growing firm and industry, disappointing early uptake could easily be framed as temporary rather than a reason to withdraw.
